facts.fact: CEPICI's director general says in an interview that the average time to create a company online was 2.4 days at mid-July 2026, with more than 4,200 RCCM transmitted online, though full dematerialisation is still being finalised.
facts.system: CEPICI platform (Guichet Unique de Formalites d'Entreprise)

note: The unique identifier (IDU) is said to give a firm one number across administrative platforms, with no tax or social security named; interoperability with DGI and CNPS is not a shared number.
